transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi. Well, I guess what brings me in is that I’ve been waking up with this... this really heavy, hollow sadness. It's just—I don't know, it feels like the studio lights are on, but there’s just no music in me anymore. I just feel incredibly sad.
Have you been feeling this sad most days for at least two years?
No, not two years. It's... well, I'd say this depressed part has been going on for about nine months now.
Did this sadness start after a specific stressful event or major life change?
No, I wouldn't say it started after anything specific. There wasn't a major stressful event or a big life change or anything like that. It just kind of... started.
Before this nine-month period, have you ever had another time in your life when you felt depressed like this?

No, I don't think so. I mean, I've had normal days where I felt a little down or tired from rehearsals, but... never anything like this. This is really the first time it's been this heavy and lasted for so long.
Along with the sadness, have you been feeling anxious or worried a lot?
No, not really. I mean... I wouldn't say I feel anxious. I have normal everyday worries, I guess, but nothing out of the ordinary. It's mostly just the sadness that I've noticed.
